description: List crates that DEPEND ON a given crate (reverse dependencies), most-downloaded first — answers "what uses <crate>", "how widely adopted is <crate>", "who depends on <crate>". Returns the total dependent count plus the top dependents with their version requirement, dependency kind, and download counts.

limit.description: Number of top dependents to return (default 20, max 100).

name: get_crate_reverse_deps
title: Get Crate Reverse Deps
